title: Create Header Component
body: Create a reusable Header component that includes the main navigation.

title: Create Hero Section Component
body: Create a reusable Hero section component for landing pages.

title: Create Services List Component
body: Create a Services List component that displays a list of services offered.

title: Create Portfolio Item Component
body: Create a Portfolio Item component that represents a single portfolio item.

title: Create Contact Form Component
body: Create a Contact Form component for visitors to get in touch.

title: Create About Section Component
body: Create an About Section component that provides information about the company.

title: Create Testimonial Component
body: Create a Testimonial component that displays customer testimonials.

title: Integrate External Services
body: Integrate any necessary external services such as Stripe, Calendly, Formspree/AWS Lambda, Strapi, Contentful, Google Analytics, SEO Tools, and SonarCloud.

title: Set Up Hosting Environment
body: Set up and configure the hosting environment on AWS S3 and CloudFront.

title: Test and Deploy Website
body: Conduct final testing, fix any bugs, and deploy the website.

title: State Management
body: Decide on a state management solution based on the complexity of the app.

title: Routing
body: Set up routing for the multi-page application using a library like React Router.

title: Testing
body: Set up testing for the components using a combination of unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests.

title: Styling
body: Decide on a styling solution, which could be traditional CSS, a preprocessor like SASS, or a CSS-in-JS solution.

title: Performance
body: Ensure the app performs well by setting up code splitting, optimizing images, or other performance enhancements.

title: Accessibility
body: Ensure the app is accessible to all users by setting up proper semantic HTML, ensuring good contrast ratios, adding alt text to images, etc.

title: Error Handling
body: Plan for how you will handle and display errors to the user.

title: Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
body: Set up a CI/CD pipeline to automate testing and deployment.
